title: On $p$-adic integral moduli schemes and local models for PEL type D
summary: We construct flat integral moduli schemes of PEL type D and the corresponding flat orthogonal Rapoport--Zink spaces with parahoric level structure over a $p$-adic integer ring. The construction relies on proving a conjecture of Pappas--Rapoport: for an even orthogonal similitude group over a complete discretely valued field of residue characteristic $p>2$, and for arbitrary parahoric level, the associated spin local model is flat, normal, Cohen--Macaulay, with reduced special fiber.
